summary: Interparfums, Inc. filed an 8-K on September 17, 2026, reporting under Item 8.01 the 20-year extension of its exclusive worldwide license with Marquee Brands for Roberto Cavalli and Just Cavalli fragrances through December 31, 2046. The press release, attached as Exhibit 99.1, quotes Chairman and CEO Jean Madar on the brand's growth. No financial terms, price per share, premium, advisor, or board recommendation were disclosed because this is an ordinary commercial licensing event, not a special situation. No deal terms, structural mechanics, or arbitrage angle apply.
